title: Anime Style
prompt: Contemporary anime illustration with confident, simplified contours, appealing stylized proportions, and large expressive eyes. Use bright flat colors and clear cel-shaded shadow shapes, keeping internal detail economical and every form immediately readable.
author: ukr8b3g-cmyk

title: 8-Bit Pixel Art
prompt: 8-bit pixel art built from discrete, grid-aligned square pixels and a tightly limited palette. Reduce forms to clear blocky silhouettes, using stepped color bands and deliberate pixel clusters for shading, with hard edges and no antialiasing.
author: ukr8b3g-cmyk

title: Pixar Animation
prompt: Pixar-inspired 3D animation rendering with appealing rounded proportions, smooth volumetric modeling, and warm subsurface scattering in skin. Gentle three-point lighting, soft shadows, and subtle ambient occlusion give the forms dimensional weight while preserving a soft, inviting finish.
author: ukr8b3g-cmyk

title: Low-Poly 3D
prompt: Low-poly rendering with visibly triangulated geometry and angular, simplified forms. Flat-shaded polygon faces create hard tonal changes between adjoining facets, replacing smooth gradients and curved surfaces with a clean geometric structure and deliberately reduced detail.
author: ukr8b3g-cmyk

title: Paper Cutout
prompt: Layered paper-cutout rendering with flat, sharply cut shapes stacked at slightly different depths. Use clean silhouettes, subtle paper texture, and narrow drop shadows between overlapping layers, creating tactile dimensionality through physical separation rather than drawn outlines or blended shading.
author: ukr8b3g-cmyk

title: Claymation
prompt: Handcrafted claymation rendering with soft, rounded forms, slight asymmetry, and visible fingerprint dents. Preserve small surface irregularities and hand-shaped contours, using warm, even light and gentle contact shadows to give the clay a tangible, softly modeled appearance.
